AI usage became a proxy for productivity.  

along the way, parts of the industry seem to have confused using AI with creating value.

We’ve become very good at measuring token consumption, code generation and velocity.

But those metrics don’t tell us whether we’re solving the right problem.

AI has dramatically reduced the “time cost”of writing software.

But it has dramatically increased the “potential cost” of building features that nobody needs.

If we’re not careful, we’ll optimise for output instead of outcomes…and still fail to deliver meaningful value.

It’s not about squeezing every last token out of a model.

It’s about making sure every token contributes to something worth building.

Because the bottleneck is no longer writing software.

It’s deciding what deserves to exist in the first place.

images.alt: Ultra-photorealistic gothic fashion portrait of a breathtakingly beautiful young woman wearing extravagant Victorian arachnid-inspired haute couture, standing directly facing the camera with elegant, coy hands gently raised beneath her chin, conveying mysterious confidence and quiet seduction. Her couture combines intricate black lace, velvet, silk, corsetry, embroidered spiderweb filigree, delicate beadwork, crimson gemstone accents, and sculptural arachnid ornamentation, crowned by an elaborate black widow-inspired headdress seamlessly integrated into an ornate Victorian updo. Her luminous porcelain skin features realistic texture with visible pores, peach fuzz, subtle freckles, glossy lips, and expressive piercing crimson-red eyes with brilliant catchlights as the unmistakable focal point. Dramatic Rembrandt-inspired lighting sculpts her face with soft yet defined cheekbone shadows, a luminous forehead and nose bridge, and rich chiaroscuro contrast while keeping her face noticeably brighter than the surrounding darkness. Behind her, powerful backlighting cuts through dense supernatural fog, creating long atmospheric shadows, glowing shafts of light, ghostly volumetric haze, drifting smoke, and an eerie ethereal aura. Giant spiders and delicate webs emerge softly from the mist, fading into an abstract surreal background with cinematic depth of field, creamy bokeh, layered fog, and selective focus. The composition emphasizes photographic realism, luxurious gothic elegance, haunting Victorian horror, subtle surrealism, rich black and deep crimson color palette, editorial fashion photography, Nikon Z9, 85mm f/1.4, razor-sharp eyes, atmospheric diffusion, masterpiece quality, portrait orientation.
